verdict.summary: Hidroelectrica delivered a strong 9M26 rebound with revenue up 28% YoY to RON 8.60bn, EBITDA of RON 4.15bn (48.2% margin), and net profit up 34% YoY to RON 3.11bn alongside RON 3.19bn operating cash flow. Fortress net-cash balance sheet leaves credit anchored solely to the Romania sovereign ceiling (BBB-).

positives: Strong 9M 2026 earnings momentum: Adj. EBITDA RON 4,132m (+27% YoY, 48% margin) and NPAT RON 3,108m (+34% YoY).
Fortress balance sheet (~0.4x net leverage) self-funding RON 1.4bn hydro/solar/storage capex.
Romania's largest zero-carbon power producer (~6.4 GW hydro) with rapid retail expansion (1.46m supply points, +56%).
negatives: Hydrological sensitivity: Q3 2026 severe drought reduced Danube flows, forcing market power purchases and cutting Q3 NPAT -26% YoY.
High state dividend payout expectations (~90% historical payout) limit excess cash retention.
Romanian sovereign/regulatory windfall tax & energy cap framework sensitivity.

background.business_overview: Romania's flagship state-controlled hydropower & renewable electricity generator and fast-growing retail supplier (BVB: H2O).
background.asset_perimeter: 187 hydropower plants (~6.4 GW) plus Crucea wind farm and expanding solar/BESS portfolio.
background.ownership_governance: ~80% owned by Romanian Ministry of Energy, ~20% free float on Bucharest Stock Exchange.
